metadata.description: School performing well across all domains with strong leadership awareness
metadata.testPurpose: Baseline validation for healthy school operations

expectedResults.s_sub: 82-88 (High perception score, leadership confident and data-aware)

challenges.description: Is student enrollment growing, stable, or declining?
challenges.responseDescription: Enrollment growing 5-8% YoY, strong admission pipeline
challenges.rationale: School has strong brand reputation and consistent growth

challenges.description: What is the student retention rate and repetition percentage?
challenges.rationale: Students are satisfied and performing well academically

challenges.description: How competitive is your admission process? Any quality concerns?
challenges.responseDescription: Selective process with 4:1 ratio, but competition increasing from tier 2 competitors
challenges.rationale: Market is becoming more competitive but school maintains selective admission standards

challenges.description: What is your teacher turnover rate?
challenges.responseDescription: 89% retention rate, 11% attrition mostly due to relocation or higher studies
challenges.rationale: Retention is good but there's room for improvement in career progression

challenges.description: How much professional development do teachers receive?
challenges.responseDescription: 56 hours/year training, regular workshops, 78% teachers have MA
challenges.rationale: Strong investment in teacher development across the board

challenges.description: Are salaries competitive and is there clear career progression?
challenges.responseDescription: Salaries at 60th percentile, but limited advancement opportunities for senior teachers
challenges.rationale: Compensation is reasonable but not highest in sector, career growth needs attention

challenges.description: What are your board exam pass rates and subject-wise performance?
challenges.responseDescription: 98.5% pass rate, 89% in top 2 grades, subject avg 85%+
challenges.rationale: Excellent academic outcomes demonstrating strong curriculum implementation

challenges.description: How effectively is curriculum implemented? Any innovation?
challenges.responseDescription: Curriculum implemented 95%+ on time, regular innovation in pedagogy, 48/60 smart classrooms
challenges.rationale: Strong curriculum execution with modern teaching methodologies

challenges.description: What is the student wellbeing situation? Any mental health concerns?
challenges.responseDescription: Wellness program in place, but counselor availability could be improved (1 counselor per 400 students)
challenges.rationale: Good wellness infrastructure but needs scaling to handle individual attention

challenges.description: How is your school perceived in the market? Brand strength?
challenges.responseDescription: Strong brand, 4.6/5 Google rating, recognized as top school in the area
challenges.rationale: School has built strong market reputation over years

challenges.description: What makes your school unique compared to competitors?
challenges.responseDescription: Clear differentiation: holistic education, strong infrastructure, expert faculty
challenges.rationale: School has distinct value proposition in market

challenges.description: How satisfied are parents? Community perception?
challenges.responseDescription: 82 NPS score, 95% parent satisfaction, strong community engagement
challenges.rationale: Parents and community are highly satisfied with school performance

challenges.description: What is your fee collection rate and financial stability?
challenges.responseDescription: 98% fee realization, 0.8% default rate, strong cash flow
challenges.rationale: Excellent financial health with strong collections

challenges.description: Are facilities safe and compliant? Any infrastructure gaps?
challenges.responseDescription: 0 safety incidents, 100% regulatory compliance, well-maintained facilities
challenges.rationale: School maintains highest safety and compliance standards

challenges.description: What is the digital adoption rate and LMS usage?
challenges.responseDescription: 92% LMS adoption, 89% active usage rate, modern tech infrastructure
challenges.rationale: School has invested in and successfully implemented digital infrastructure

summaryStatistics.severityOverallAssessment: School is in HEALTHY state with minor challenges in staff progression and student counseling
